reasons: The file is simple, but its checks are incomplete on their own.

terms.meaning: a plain data shape used to pass information between parts of the app

sections.name: File setup, MatchDTO, TeamPlayerDTO, FantasyTeamDTO, ContestEntryDTO, StandingDTO
sections.title: Browser data shapes
sections.what: Describes the match, player, team, crew entry and standing shapes the server returns. Dates are sent as text.
sections.why: Likely reason: a fixed shape keeps the browser and server in agreement.

sections.name: submitTeamInput, SubmitTeamInput
sections.title: Team submission form rules
sections.what: Describes the input for submitting a team: a match, a non-empty player list, a captain and a vice-captain, each with a message.
sections.why: Likely reason: basic checks run before the game rules.
sections.watch_out: These rules do not check counts or that the captain and vice-captain are in the team.

summary: Defines the shapes of contest data sent to the browser and the form rules for submitting a team.
why: Likely reason: shared shapes keep the screens and the server in agreement.
how: 1. Define plain shapes for matches, players, teams, entries and standings. 2. Define the team submission form rule with messages.
outputs: Type shapes and the submission form rule.
risks: The form rule does not check the number of players or that captain and vice-captain are in the team. The game rules check must do that.
debug: If the screen shows missing fields, compare the shape with what the service returns.
